title: the instanceizer retires and the bus delivers only to devices
intention: The instanceizer is deleted and the bus delivers only to devices: no folder or held-tool fallback and no declaration files; CodeMother's held charter backpack is a plain DataRecorder at her own tool path, reached by her charter and feedback verbs.
why: Outline 19.16 (Akien, 2026-11-07): the press office is not a device but could receive feedback, so a data recorder was put there, 'and the rest of this NONSENSE grew out of that'; only devices are on the bus. Rule 1.3.7: code no longer needed is deleted. Measured 2026-11-08: no non-proof code posts to a non-device addressee.
how: Extend the shared retirement proof with four teeth (red first); delete the tool and the folder-mail proof; cut the bus's folder delivery and address.folder_path; CodeMother builds her backpack directly; her proofs, probe and held charter follow; the rackmount proof marks its letters; instance-space declarations and folders go; recompile the lab.

clauses.claim: cairn/tools/instanceizer and the bus proof test_folder_mail_lands_late.py are absent
no repo file outside records of truth and caches names cairn.tools.instanceizer, its path, the declaration file name, the bus's folder-delivery functions or address.folder_path
importing cairn.tools.instanceizer.instanceizer exits nonzero with No module named
no declaration file stands under the live instance root and its folders/ does not exist

decisions.text: D1: extend the red-first proof bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py with PROVES['7778e24dd82e'] = {'1': 'instanceizer_paths_are_absent', '2': 'nothing_names_the_instanceizer', '3': 'the_instanceizer_does_not_import', '4': 'no_declaration_stands_in_instance_space'}. Tooth 1: cairn/tools/instanceizer and cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_folder_mail_lands_late.py are absent. Tooth 2: _naming over the module cairn.tools.instanceizer, its path, the declaration file name, and the bus names _try_folder_delivery, _instance_folder, _folder_recorders and the address function folder_path (all spelled split, so the proof never names them whole) finds nothing. Tooth 3: python3 -c 'import cairn.tools.instanceizer.instanceizer' exits nonzero with 'No module named'. Tooth 4: no file named the declaration name stands anywhere under the live instance root (address.ROOTS['instance']), and <instance root>/folders does not exist. The earlier tickets' teeth are unchanged. Run red before the build: all four FAIL.

D2: delete cairn/tools/instanceizer/ whole: its intention+why.json and every validations/*.json leave first through bin/cairn artifact remove <path> --why, then git rm -r the rest. Delete cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_folder_mail_lands_late.py and its validations json the same way (it measures only the folder path).

D3: the bus delivers only to devices. In cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/bus.py delete _instance_folder, _try_folder_delivery, _folder_write and the self._folder_recorders cache (its __init__ line and any reset), and in post() remove the 'elif self._try_folder_delivery(to, envelope): pass' branch so a personal post with no hook goes straight to the asker-gave-up and no-receiver branches. Any docstring or comment naming folder delivery says instead that only devices are on the bus (outline 19.16, ticket 7778e24dd82e). In cairn/tools/base/address.py delete folder_path and the FOLDERS constant (no other caller). In cairn/devices/cairn/intention+why.json drop '~/.cairn/folders/press_office' from owns through write_json (verb append, why naming this ticket).

D4: CodeMother's held backpack without a declaration. In cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py add charter_backpack(roots=None) returning DataRecorder(charter_instance(roots) / _CHARTER_DATA) (import from cairn.tools.data_recorder.data_recorder); ensure_charter_instance mkdirs that inbound folder (parents, exist_ok) and returns {'address', 'backpack' (the inbound path), 'tool_class': 'cairn/tools/charter', 'records'}; _handle_charter and _handle_feedback use charter_backpack() in place of load(charter_instance()); drop _CHARTER_BACKPACK and rewrite the block comment above it to say the life is the data_recorder backpack at inbound/, reached by her charter and feedback verbs (no declaration; ticket 7778e24dd82e). In cairn/devices/codemother/probes/charter_feedback_reaches.py survey reads charter_backpack(): ensured is the inbound folder existing, records its read(). In cairn/devices/codemother/0/tools/charter/intention+why.json (write_json, verb append) rewrite what, assembly (backpack: tool_class DataRecorder, data_path inbound, no declaration; ensured_by unchanged; reached_by: codemother's charter and feedback verbs, only devices are on the bus) and add to traces_to 'ticket 7778e24dd82e (outline 19.16)'.

D5: CodeMother's proofs. cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_charter_held.py: tooth 1 asserts the inbound folder is absent before and present after ensure_charter_instance, out['backpack'] == str(held/'inbound'), and ensured twice returns the same backpack; delete test_a_message_to_charter_lands_in_the_held_inbound and PROVES['65b34c57ab71'] key '2', with a docstring line that ticket 7778e24dd82e retired clause (2) with the instanceizer (outline 19.16: only devices are on the bus), as 164da559823d D6 did; tooth 4 asserts no declaration file stands at the held instance and its only child is inbound. Rewrite the docstring rows for (1), (2), (4) and the hollow paragraph to match. cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_feedback_verb.py: read records through cm.charter_backpack().read().

D6: cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py: drop the instanceizer and address imports and the shutil/contextlib scratch if unused; _inbox(label) returns only the testing-marked name (no folder); _TestingBus gains post(**kw) that adds the testing mark (testing_mark.FIELD: testing_mark.mark('20a97889646e')) to the body before passing to the live bus, so the no-receiver bounce inherits the mark and the bus disposes of it as test debris; the end-to-end tooth asserts the poke body minus FIELD == {'alert': 'cpu_threshold', 'crossed': 80}; the docstring's inbox sentence says the inboxes are marked names the bus disposes of.

D7: instance-space: copy ~/.cairn/folders/ to the session scratchpad, then remove it whole (press_office's two stale WATCHME records and two rackmount testing folders), and remove ~/.cairn/devices/codemother/0/tools/charter/instanceizer.json (inbound/ stays). Recompile the lab with cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh. Run the proof green twice and every edited proof once (cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_charter_held.py, cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_feedback_verb.py, cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py, the bus proofs dir, the base address proofs); commit; seal; PROVEME; hollow seal; forwarding order after the deletion.

out: the bus's device delivery and no-receiver path

measured.saw: every Probe(...) pokes harbor_master, librarian, BUILD_GATE.notifies or a caller address; no non-proof post to charter or press_office; the held inbound's 144 sail records came via the feedback verb; two live declarations under ~/.cairn
measured.how: grep over class-space; a count of probe_source in the inbound records.jsonl; find ~/.cairn -name the declaration
